subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this grouped one-Claw/one-new-agent v1 schema and gated read-only CLI as the foundation of the still-open Claws RFC implementation series?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded and read-only, but it establishes durable manifest, CLI, ownership, diagnostic, and JSON compatibility surfaces that code review cannot authorize without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Pause for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep this PR open until maintainers accept or narrow the linked RFC, then require exact-head safety proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental foundation
options.body: Explicitly approve the current gated contract as an unstable incubation surface while reserving the right to revise it before general availability.

options.title: Narrow the first slice
options.body: Reduce the initial schema or command surface and defer disputed ownership fields until later RFC decisions settle.

recommendation.title: Pause for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until maintainers accept or narrow the linked RFC, then require exact-head safety proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the most comprehensive product-model and owner-boundary review and are already identified in the RFC discussion as the strongest visible contract-decision owner.
